meaning.en: Wiring or signal between indoor and outdoor unit is missing or abnormal; unit locks out.
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor unit ke darmiyan wiring ya signal ghayb ya ghair mamuli hai; unit lock ho jata hai.

causes.ur: IDU–ODU wire open ho ya ulti lagi ho

causes.en: Outdoor board dead or no 220 V from IDU terminal
causes.ur: Outdoor board band ho ya IDU terminal se 220 V na aa raha ho

causes.en: Communication circuit / optocoupler fault on PCB
causes.ur: PCB par communication circuit/optocoupler kharab ho

solutions.en: Check L/N/1 wiring and earth between units
solutions.ur: Dono units ke darmiyan L/N/1 aur earth wiring check karein

solutions.en: Verify 220 V at ODU terminal and ODU PCB LED5 behaviour
solutions.ur: ODU terminal par 220 V aur ODU PCB ke LED5 ka behaviour verify karein

solutions.en: Replace IDU or ODU PCB per flow chart
solutions.ur: Flow chart ke mutabiq IDU ya ODU PCB badlein

title.ur: Indoor main-PCB aur display-board ki communication kharab

meaning.en: Indoor controller cannot talk to its display/keypad board.
meaning.ur: Indoor controller apni display/keypad board se baat nahi kar sakta.

causes.ur: Display ribbon/connector dheela ho jaye
Display board bilkul band ho jaye
Indoor main PCB kharab ho

solutions.en: Power off at the breaker for a few minutes before touching the display ribbon.
solutions.ur: Display ribbon ko haath lagane se pehle breaker se kuch minute ke liye power band karein.

solutions.en: Open the display panel, re-seat the ribbon/connector and check for bent or oxidized pins; the connector should sit square and firm.
solutions.ur: Display panel khol kar ribbon/connector dobara lagayein aur tedhe ya zang lage pins check karein; connector seedha aur mazboot baith jaye.

solutions.en: If the code stays, swap in a known-good display board; if the fault follows the board, replace the display board, otherwise replace the indoor main PCB.
solutions.ur: Code aaye to display board ko kisi chalte hue board se badal kar dekhein; masla board ke sath chala jaye to display board badlein, warna indoor main PCB badlein.

source.title: TCL TAC-09CSD/XA81I Service Manual (§3.1 Failure code, §3.2 Trouble shooting); corroborated by TAC-09CHSD/FCI Service Manual, ERA YA11I Service Manual, manua.ls TAC-12CSD FAQ, acerrorcode.com

codes.blinkPattern: Indoor IDU failure group (XA81I table remark: IDU failure)

meaning.en: Parameter memory on outdoor board unreadable/corrupt.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board ki parameter memory parhi nahi ja sakti.

causes.ur: EEPROM chip kharab ho jaye
Power surge ke baad parameters kharab ho jaye
PCB kharab ho

solutions.en: Turn off power and pull the mains plug before opening any board.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi board kholne se pehle power band kar ke mains plug nikalein.

solutions.en: Power-cycle the unit first; if the code clears, back up the model parameters so a later surge cannot corrupt them again.
solutions.ur: Pehle unit ka power-cycle karein; code clear ho jaye to model parameters ka backup le lein taake baad mein surge se phir kharab na hon.

solutions.en: Re-flash the EEPROM with the correct file, or replace the outdoor board if parameters keep resetting, then restore the model parameters.
solutions.ur: EEPROM ko sahi file se re-flash karein, ya parameters reset hote rahein to outdoor board badlein, phir model parameters wapas set karein.

title.en: Suction / gas-return pipe temperature sensor fault
title.ur: Suction/gas-return pipe ka temperature sensor kharab

meaning.en: Suction (gas-return) pipe sensor open/short on series that list EH.
meaning.ur: Suction (gas-return) pipe sensor khula/short hai (EH wali series par).

causes.ur: Sensor ka connector dheela ho jaye
Thermistor open ya short ho jaye
Board ka input kharab ho

solutions.en: Power off at the breaker before accessing the pipe sensor.
solutions.ur: Pipe sensor tak pahunchne se pehle breaker se power band karein.

solutions.en: Re-seat the sensor connector and inspect the wire along the suction pipe for damage; a tight connector should restore a steady reading.
solutions.ur: Sensor connector dobara lagayein aur suction pipe ke sath lagi wire ko damage ke liye dekhein; mazboot connector lagne par reading theek ho jani chahiye.

solutions.en: Measure the thermistor against the manual chart and replace it if it is open or short; if the reading stays wrong, replace the board input.
solutions.ur: Manual ke chart se thermistor naapein, open/short ho to badlein; reading ghalat hi rahe to board ka input badlein.

meaning.en: After 9 min at high frequency, coil temperatures barely change while discharge stays high — refrigerant likely low.
meaning.ur: 9 minute tak high frequency par coil temperature poori tarah nahi badalti jabki discharge temperature upar hi rehti hai — refrigerant shayad kam hai.

causes.ur: Refrigerant (gas) leak ho jaye
Repair ke baad gas kam charge ho
Flow ruk jaye ya block ho jaye

solutions.en: Switch the unit off before leak testing; only a trained technician should handle refrigerant.
solutions.ur: Leak test se pehle unit band karein aur refrigerant sirf trained technician hi handle kare.

solutions.en: Leak-test all joints, repair the leak, then evacuate and recharge to the manual specification.
solutions.ur: Sabhi joints ka leak test karein, leak theek karein, phir vacuum kar ke manual ke mutabiq gas charge karein.

solutions.en: After recharging, check the filter/drier for restriction and clear it if the pressure stays low.
solutions.ur: Gas bharne ke baad filter/drier mein rukawat check karein aur pressure kam rahe to usay kholein.

meaning.en: Indoor TVOC/air-quality sensor optional module failed.
meaning.ur: Indoor TVOC/air-quality sensor ka optional module kharab ho gaya.

causes.ur: Sensor module disconnect ho jaye
Sensor module band ho jaye

solutions.en: Power off the indoor unit before pulling the optional module.
solutions.ur: Optional module nikalne se pehle indoor unit band karein.

solutions.en: Re-seat the TVOC module connector and check the cable for damage; the plug should be fully home.
solutions.ur: TVOC module ka connector dobara lagayein aur cable damage ke liye dekhein; plug poori tarah andar baith jaye.

solutions.en: If the module is still dead, replace the TVOC module.
solutions.ur: Module ab bhi band ho to TVOC module badlein.

meaning.en: Indoor PM2.5 sensor optional module failed.
meaning.ur: Indoor PM2.5 sensor ka optional module kharab ho gaya.

causes.ur: Module disconnect ho jaye
Sensor bilkul band ho jaye

solutions.en: Turn off power before removing the PM2.5 module.
solutions.ur: PM2.5 module nikalne se pehle power band karein.

solutions.en: Re-seat the module connector and check the wiring; the connection must be firm and clean.
solutions.ur: Module connector dobara lagayein aur wiring check karein; connection mazboot aur saaf hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Replace the PM2.5 module if it stays dead after re-seating.
solutions.ur: Dobara lagane ke baad bhi module band rahe to PM2.5 module badlein.

meaning.en: Indoor humidity sensor open/short or module failed.
meaning.ur: Indoor humidity sensor khula/short ho ya module kharab ho gaya.

causes.ur: Connector dheela ho jaye
Sensor kharab ho jaye

solutions.en: Power off before disconnecting the humidity sensor module.
solutions.ur: Humidity sensor module disconnect karne se pehle power band karein.

solutions.en: Reconnect the plug and check the connector pins; they must be straight and free of corrosion.
solutions.ur: Plug dobara jor dein aur connector pins check karein; pins seedhe hone chahiye aur zang na laga ho.

solutions.en: Replace the humidity sensor module if the code remains.
solutions.ur: Code rahe to humidity sensor module badlein.
